_comment: Mid-season roster hand-offs. A Sleeper roster keeps its roster_id when its owner changes, and Sleeper's /rosters reports only the CURRENT owner, so without this file every week of the season is attributed to whoever holds the roster at fetch time. Each entry: weeks < effectiveWeek belong to fromOwnerId, weeks >= effectiveWeek to toOwnerId. Owner by Sleeper user_id, never by name. Read by src/public_league/ownership.py.
